summary: An old policy about where apartments belong becomes the sticking point for a particular parcel.
realLife: Opponents of Lincoln Green cited a village policy favoring apartments between houses and incompatible uses. The proposed site did not border industry or commerce.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with parcel, neighboring use, policy. The board can read the zoning map aloud when the builder asks which boundary fails the policy.

turns.what: A member finds a commercial parcel on the boundary staff described as residential.
turns.pulledBy: The current map records a change since the staff report was written.
turns.writesBack: The board requests a corrected map before relying on the buffer policy.

turns.what: Only the narrow end of the parcel touches the shops across the alley.
turns.pulledBy: The survey shows houses along the rest of the property line.
turns.writesBack: The commission's recommendation describes each boundary separately.
